description: Speed-unit surface hidden when the ADAS fusion master switch is OFF. can[0]=0x4C1 value 0 -> safeDrivingAssistFusionSwitch off clears the derived flags so SpeedUnitShow stays 0; diSpeedUnitSurface Draw() returns early and no unit text is rendered.

can.desc: HUD_Safe_Driving_Assistant_Fusion_Switch_Settings_S: ADAS fusion master switch OFF -> speed/eunit gate closed
